study.question: At the frozen strongest joint starting point, which auxiliary combinations reverse the harmful cart-only shared-context effect, and does the joint advantage survive a simple aggregate-coefficient explanation?
study.hypothesis: Observed: joint_replay exactly reproduced the imported joint click AUC 0.668457307890924; click_only and aux_context_blocked both scored 0.6678548720585206; aux_batch_roll scored 0.6674639465810746. Cart-only/fav-only/buy-only/fav+buy context participation scored 0.6674277598220023/0.6677933678779057/0.6673203922314733/0.6677967453158369. Thus the cart marginal changes from -0.0004271122365182567 on the empty background to +0.0006605625750870647 on fav+buy, a descriptive 0.0010876748116053214 interaction on this seed. No new run or mechanistic measurement is implied. H_pair: at least one of fav or buy is sufficient to reverse cart transfer through the two existing context adapters. H_composition: the benefit also depends on task composition rather than just the sum of auxiliary transfer coefficients. Different task combinations may shape useful shared context representations, but this remains provisional; repeated initialization is not a separate mechanism contrast.

study.proposed_difference: Implement cart+fav and cart+buy at context scale1 to complete the 2^3 auxiliary adapter-context participation factorial together with the six existing matched vertices (empty, each singleton, fav+buy, all). Add fav+buy scale1.5 and all-three scale2/3 as a second 2x2 composition-by-nominal-total-coefficient contrast using existing fav+buy scale1 and joint scale1: coefficient totals2 and3 for both compositions. Scale ONLY the backward derivative of the shared context tensor before BOTH adapters. A module-local autograd identity returns an exact tensor view and multiplies its incoming derivative by the declared scalar; inactive labels detach and scale1 bypasses it. Private parameter gradients and forward values at fixed weights are unchanged. These are deliberately modified backward rules, not gradients of a reweighted scalar loss. No host loss weighting or recipe override is introduced.
predictions: Use a predeclared practical click-AUC tolerance epsilon=0.0002 for descriptive decisions, not a significance threshold. H_pair predicts at least one of A(cart+fav)-A(fav) or A(cart+buy)-A(buy) is >=epsilon, whereas the inherited A(cart)-A(empty) is negative. Inspect every vertex regardless of sign. Neither missing pair succeeding would falsify this pair-sufficiency hypothesis and motivate a separate three-way/optimization question.

H_composition predicts A(all,2/3)-A(fav+buy,1) >=epsilon at nominal total2 AND A(all,1)-A(fav+buy,1.5) >=epsilon at nominal total3. Failure of either leaves this stronger composition claim unsupported; opposite or mixed results must be reported without selecting a favorable total.

For the binary factorial, compute cart:fav interaction on buy=0 as A(cf)-A(c)-A(f)+A(empty), cart:buy on fav=0 as A(cb)-A(c)-A(b)+A(empty), their conditional counterparts with the third task present, and I_cfb=A(cfb)-A(cf)-A(cb)-A(fb)+A(c)+A(f)+A(b)-A(empty). Compute all other pair marginals too. Endpoint AUC interactions describe training trajectories and do not by themselves identify gradient conflict or label-information synergy.

Before optimization, all four variants must match inherited joint probabilities and Dice updates at identical weights and inputs. At nonzero adapter output weights, each selected task context derivative is its declared scalar times the corresponding open derivative; unselected context derivatives are zero. Private derivatives are unchanged at that fixed state. No inference speed improvement is predicted.

Retain the original joint model as incumbent unless prospective validation and subsequent paired repetition support replacement; null or inferior proposed variants are useful attribution results, not scientific success.
falsifiers: Any difference in same-state forward values, initialization RNG, parameters/buffers, task masks, labels, or unexpected item/scorer/tower-context derivative leakage invalidates the implementation comparison; fix before host training, retain charged failed receipts.
Both cart-containing pair marginal effects below epsilon reject H_pair at this observed seed, even if the all-three endpoint remains better.

Fav+buy1.5 matching/exceeding joint1 within epsilon and/or joint2/3 losing its advantage over fav+buy1 undermines H_composition and supports investigating coefficient/optimizer dynamics. A positive pair or triple endpoint interaction alone does not reject that alternative.

Loss of the joint advantage over blocked/click-only in authorized paired-seed follow-up weakens the initial auxiliary-utility claim. No seed significance or repeated support is claimed from the current receipts.

Coefficient-sum matching is not norm-, direction-, optimizer-update-, or compute-matching. Even both positive composition contrasts leave gradient geometry and useful semantics unresolved without additional authorized measurements.
alternative_explanations: One inherited seed with validation-adaptive choice of question; no confirmatory uncertainty estimate or independent replication
Binary participation changes aggregate gradient direction and size simultaneously; nonlinear optimization and Adagrad accumulators can create nonadditive endpoint AUC
Private auxiliary modules subsequently co-adapt to changed shared embeddings; endpoint performance alone does not measure semantic complementarity or gradient alignment
Any embedding-table aliases across context and item fields must be checked by the host; ownership is by graph edge, not assumed table separation
Auxiliary labels reflect user/category/brand actions within24h, not ad-specific attribution; benchmark offline delayed actions and static vocab/snapshot assumptions constrain transfer to deployment.

Nominal coefficient totals count tasks with unequal BCE prevalence, context derivative magnitude and curvature; total3 does not mean equal measured gradient norm. Dense global clipping may indirectly change downstream dense updates after trajectories diverge.

Same-seed joint replay is deterministic reproduction, not independent repeated support. The rolled-label control changes label relationships and private learning as well as information content, so it does not prove informative gradient alignment.
